source_types.derived_ibge_2022: calculated only from Censo 2022 values, with assumed weights
source_types.observed_mapbiomas_2024: satellite land cover, 30 m, cannot see single street trees
source_types.observed_cnefe_2022: CNEFE 2022 addresses counted per tract by their coordinates
source_types.modeled_cnefe_range: bound of a solar range built on CNEFE counts; shows uncertainty, not a measurement
source_types.observed_urbverde_landsat_2025: UrbVerde 2025 surface temperature anomaly, Landsat 30 m, summarised per tract here; surface, not air
source_types.derived_cnefe_2022: calculated only from CNEFE 2022 counts; an address proxy, not a survey of jobs or buildings
source_types.modeled_proxy: formula with assumed coefficients, not a measurement
source_types.modeled_placeholder: assumed value with no measurement of this quantity behind it; shows no real differences in behaviour or exposure
source_types.scenario_baseline: starting value for a policy slider
source_types.no_source: no data source yet; left empty rather than invented
